name: Eventstream HTTP Connector GA
description: The Eventstream HTTP connector is generally available in Microsoft Fabric, enabling you to ingest data from external HTTP APIs into Eventstream for real-time processing and analytics.With this capability, you can:- Connect to supported external HTTP APIs to ingest data.- Process incoming data using Eventstream transformations.- Route data to supported destinations for analysis and action.

result.descriptionEs: El conector HTTP de Eventstream pasa a disponibilidad general para ingerir datos de APIs HTTP externas, transformarlos con Eventstream y enviarlos a destinos compatibles para análisis y acción.
